stories.title: Le peuple se prononcera sur la construction de nouvelles centrales nucléaires

en.title: The public will vote on the construction of new nuclear power plants
en.summary: Swiss voters will likely decide against building new nuclear power plants after more than 125,000 people signed a referendum petition within three months opposing a parliamentary proposal from June.

stories.title: Responsable de Valeurs actuelles, Charles Sapin ne sera plus sur France Inter pour son édito contesté

en.title: Charles Sapin, head of Valeurs actuelles, will no longer appear on France Inter for his controversial editorial
en.summary: A leader of the far-right magazine Valeurs actuelles declined France Inter's proposal to transform his editorial slot into a debate format and will stop appearing on the station following two broadcasts and strike action.

stories.title: 1:3-Niederlage in Rio – Auch das Doppel geht verloren: Schweiz unterliegt Brasilien

en.title: 1:3 loss in Rio – The doubles match is also lost: Switzerland loses to Brazil
en.summary: Switzerland's Davis Cup team suffered a clear defeat in Rio de Janeiro and remains in World Group I.

stories.title: Des opposants à l'avortement défilent à Zurich accompagnés d'un gros dispositif policier

en.title: Anti-abortion protesters march in Zurich with heavy police presence
en.summary: More than a thousand abortion opponents participated in a 'march for life' in Zurich-Oerlikon on Saturday, where masked cyclists disrupted the event and police deployed significant forces.

stories.title: LIVE-TICKER - Iran-Krieg: Huthis melden Angriff auf Riad mit ballistischen Raketen +++ Teheran will zurück zu Rahmenabkommen

en.title: LIVE TICKER - Iran War: Houthis Report Attack on Riyadh with Ballistic Missiles +++ Tehran Wants to Return to Framework Agreement
en.summary: The US and Iran have been in a state of war since February 2026. Following a ceasefire that US President Donald Trump declared ended in early July, the Houthis report attacks on Saudi Arabia while Tehran signals willingness to return to a framework agreement.

stories.title: Avec plus de 125 000 signatures, le référendum contre le retour du nucléaire a largement abouti

en.title: With More Than 125,000 Signatures, the Referendum Against Nuclear Energy's Return Clearly Succeeded
en.summary: A referendum launched in late June opposing new nuclear power plant construction gathered over 125,000 signatures in three months, far exceeding the required threshold. Swiss voters will decide on this matter.

stories.title: MTB-Weltcup in Soldier Hollow – Keller und Frei auf Short-Track-Podest – Berta mit Premieren-Sieg

en.title: MTB World Cup in Soldier Hollow – Keller and Frei on Short-Track Podium – Berta with Debut Victory
en.summary: Martina Berta achieved her first victory at an MTB World Cup event in Soldier Hollow. Swiss riders Alessandra Keller and Sina Frei completed the podium.

stories.title: Krieg im Nahen Osten – Huthi-Miliz reklamiert erneut Angriffe auf Saudi-Arabien für sich

en.title: War in the Middle East – Houthi Militia Claims Attacks on Saudi Arabia Again
en.summary: The Houthi militia claimed responsibility again for attacks on Saudi Arabia. The conflict is part of an ongoing dispute in Yemen, where Saudi Arabia supports the government.

stories.title: L'accès à la Maison Blanche interdit à trois médias, conformément à une annonce de Donald Trump

en.title: White House access banned for three media outlets, in line with Donald Trump's announcement
en.summary: Journalists from CNN, MSNBC, and Politico were denied entry to the White House on Saturday after Trump announced the restriction the previous day. The measure has drawn widespread criticism as a threat to press freedom.

stories.title: LIVE-TICKER - Krieg in der Ukraine: Berichte von Cyberangriff bei Wahlen in Russland +++ Trump unterzeichnet Sanktionspaket gegen Russland

en.title: LIVE TICKER - War in Ukraine: Reports of cyberattack during Russian elections +++ Trump signs sanctions package against Russia
en.summary: Coverage of ongoing developments in Russia's war against Ukraine, including reported cyberattacks during Russian elections and new U.S. sanctions signed by Trump.

stories.title: Donald Trump interdit l'accès à la Maison Blanche aux médias CNN, MSNOW et Politico

en.title: Donald Trump bans White House access for CNN, MSNBC and Politico media
en.summary: Trump announced Friday that CNN, MSNBC, and Politico will be immediately barred from accessing the White House, escalating his confrontation with media outlets.

stories.title: Krieg in der Ukraine – Trump unterzeichnet Sanktionsgesetz gegen Russland

en.title: War in Ukraine – Trump signs sanctions law against Russia
en.summary: U.S. President Trump has signed congressional legislation imposing new sanctions on Russia.

stories.title: Militärflugzeuge statt Autos: Die Aufrüstung in Europa füllt die Auftragsbücher der Schweizer Industrie

en.title: Military aircraft instead of cars: European rearmament fills Swiss industry's order books
en.summary: European military buildup driven by concerns about Russia is boosting demand for Swiss machinery, electrical, and metal industry products, particularly advanced technology used in defense manufacturing.

stories.title: Die Migros tüftelt an der Revolution: Werden die zehn Regionalgenossenschaften abgeschafft?

en.title: Migros engineers a revolution: Will the ten regional cooperatives be abolished?
en.summary: Migros is planning organizational changes to address efficiency concerns, potentially dismantling its ten regional cooperatives, which could overturn a core legacy of founder Gottlieb Duttweiler.

stories.title: INTERVIEW - Früherer EU-Chef Jean-Claude Juncker: «Ich verstehe manche Bedenken gegenüber diesen Verträgen»

en.title: INTERVIEW - Former EU Chief Jean-Claude Juncker: "I understand some concerns about these agreements"
en.summary: Jean-Claude Juncker, former EU Commission president, discusses EU power, Swiss neutrality limits, and explains his expectations regarding the EU package in relation to the cantonal chamber vote.

stories.title: Rolex mit Mondphase, Hublot mit Jeff Koons: Der Uhrenherbst bringt einige Überraschungen

en.title: Rolex with moon phase, Hublot with Jeff Koons: The autumn watch season brings some surprises
en.summary: Rolex is reviving a vintage timepiece once nicknamed the "big frying pan" by Italian collectors. Hublot collaborates with renowned pop artist Jeff Koons, while Blancpain introduces an unexpectedly compact mechanical watch.

stories.title: INTERVIEW - Die Schweizer Organisation Macroscopic Ventures wurde mit Anthropic reich – ihr Mitgründer sagt: «In einigen Jahren wird KI die physische Welt direkt beeinflussen»

en.title: INTERVIEW - Swiss organization Macroscopic Ventures became rich with Anthropic – its co-founder says: "In a few years, AI will directly influence the physical world"
en.summary: Macroscopic Ventures, a Swiss organization that profited from Anthropic investment, focuses on researching AI risks. Co-founder Jonas Vollmer discusses concerns about granting artificial intelligence increasing control over physical systems.
